name: Feni
source:
The younger sister of the [url=https://vndb.org/c132903]manager[/url] of the “Paradise Research” club. She is somewhat timid and restless, but also has a stronger side that firmly supports her aimless older brother. 

[Taken from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]
